name: FuVR
summary: Stream PCVR from your Mac over USB or Wi-Fi.
description:
FuVR is an open-source PCVR streaming client for Meta Quest. It pairs with the FuVR daemon on Apple Silicon Macs and renders OpenXR-rendered frames produced on the Mac. No SteamVR, no Quest Link, no reverse engineering — the wire format and OpenXR runtime are documented in the open-source repository.

Use the matching macOS build for a working pair; mismatched versions are rejected at the control-channel handshake.
